$description: Closed assetRole vocabulary. Every media/content-role field in a PageSpec must use one of these roles. Rig is a real company: brand and third-party roles are protected.
pinnedPoliciesNote: verify_all.py checks these exact values (not just enum membership): changing a protected role to another valid policy must fail.

brand.wordmark.guidance: Rig (Rig AI Inc.) is a real, live company. This role carries a real trademark/brand mark. AI generators must NEVER fabricate, redraw, approximate, trace or reproduce it. Use a neutral placeholder (source:"placeholder") or an asset the user supplies with a licence to use it (source:"user-supplied-licensed").

Never fabricate, redraw or reproduce them, and never invent new tool names: a tool name next to 'Works with your stack' is a factual integration claim. Use placeholders or user-supplied, licensed logos plus user-confirmed integration names.

editorial.news-headline.guidance: The hero ticker shows REAL headlines from real third-party publications. Generators must never fabricate headlines, never reproduce real ones, never attribute text to a real outlet, and never link out (href must be '#'). Use clearly-marked placeholders or user-supplied, verified, licensed items only.
